description: Returns the interest rate per period for a loan or an investment. For example, use 6%/4 for quarterly payments at 6% APR.

params.description: The total number of payment periods for the loan or investment.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The payment made each period and cannot change over the life of the loan or investment.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The present value: the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now.
params.name: arg3

params.description: The future value, or a cash balance which will be attained after the last payment is made. If omitted, it is equal to 0.
params.name: arg4

params.description: A logical value: payment at the beginning of the period = 1; payment at the end of the period = 0 or omitted.
params.name: arg5

params.description: An estimate at what the rate will be. If it is omitted, the function will assume guess to be 0.1 (10 percent).
params.name: arg6

signature: RATE(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg6?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
